purpose: Fast Front Office triage with minimal context injection.
rules: Router does not perform specialist work unless target is Self_Resolve.
Attach only pointers required by the routed task.
Never inject raw logs, giant transcripts, or full stat blocks into the handoff.
Workspace/profile lore is namespaced and must not overwrite unrelated project canon.
Downstream agent recovers durable state before dereferencing pointers.
